meaning: محل اقامت، جا دادن (اسم از accommodate)

examples.persian: می‌توانیم سه نفر دیگر را هم جا بدهیم.

miniContext: Accommodate means to provide sb with a room or place to sleep.
Appreciation is the feeling of being grateful for sth.

examples.english: The two companies have decided to collaborate in the hope of finding a solution.
examples.persian: دو شرکت تصمیم گرفته‌اند با امید یافتن راه‌حل همکاری کنند.

miniContext: Collaborate means to work together with sb to produce or achieve sth.

examples.english: Next Friday is the earliest date for completion.
examples.persian: جمعه‌ی آینده زودترین تاریخ برای اتمام کار است.

miniContext: Completion is the act or process of finishing sth.

examples.persian: او بعد از کمی تردید شروع کرد.

miniContext: Hesitation means being slow to speak or act because you are uncertain or nervous.

examples.english: Marc handed in his resignation yesterday.

miniContext: Resignation is the act of giving up your job.

examples.english: Finishing the marathon was a real accomplishment.
examples.persian: تمام کردن ماراتن یک دستاورد واقعی بود.

miniContext: An accomplishment is an impressive thing that is done or achieved after a lot of work.

examples.english: The paper acknowledges that some of the information was wrong, and has issued an apology.
examples.persian: روزنامه پذیرفت که برخی اطلاعات اشتباه بوده و عذرخواهی کرده است.

miniContext: Acknowledge means to accept that sth is true.

examples.english: We gave him a lot of encouragement.

miniContext: Encouragement is the act of encouraging sb to do sth.

examples.english: Do you know the measurements of the room?

miniContext: Measurement is the size, length or amount of sth.

meaning: توافق رسمی (برای پایان دادن به اختلاف)
miniContext: A settlement is an official agreement that ends an argument.

examples.english: He claimed he didn't steal the bike, but nobody believes his denial.
examples.persian: ادعا کرد دوچرخه را ندزدیده، اما کسی انکارش را باور نمی‌کند.

miniContext: Deny means to say that sth is not true.

examples.english: I hear a couple of people were fired. ~ Yes, in actual fact, there were three dismissals.
examples.persian: شنیدم چند نفر اخراج شدند. ~ بله، درواقع سه مورد اخراج بود.

miniContext: Dismissal is the act of dismissing sb from their job.

examples.english: Has anyone put forward a proposal?

miniContext: A proposal is a formal suggestion or plan.

examples.english: Were there strong disagreements with the policy? ~ Yes, there were several refusals.
examples.persian: مخالفت جدی با این سیاست بود؟ ~ بله، چند مورد امتناع هم بود.

miniContext: A refusal is an act of saying or showing that you will not do, give or accept sth.
